accel_query_sql: SELECT region,sum(value) total,avg(value) mean,count(value) present,min(value) lo,max(value) hi,count(*) n FROM (WITH report AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT region,LEAST(GREATEST(price/NULLIF(adjustment,0),-100),100) value FROM bench_scalar_sales) SELECT region,value FROM report) derived GROUP BY region
